notes.title: Last weeks release notes
notes.notes:
Greetings,

we made some small changes last week, but forgot to add the change notes.

Here they are:

There was an error with one of the buildings, it never unlocked after the mission was successful. This issue is fixed - not only for new games - but also for all the old games. Load your game and you automatically will have the building unlocked.

A fix was made, that the win conditions in vs beats battles can be not only by killing them but also by capturing them.

Added shortkeys for skills in battles, you can now freely chose your keystroke from 1-9 to be bound to the chosen skill.

notes.title: Patch notes for this week: DRM free & Shortcuts
notes.notes:
We did improve some things and fix some more, here is what actually changed for this weeks updates:


    Fixed the positions of two city halls, as they were overlapped by other buildings and could not be selected.
    Fixed some 'protect the chets' battles, that were possible to win instantly.
    Fixed a crash when dragging the battle map, while aiming.
    Added keyboard shortcuts for the menu UI.
    Added buttons to sell all resources in the Resource Market.
    Made the game run independently from Steam, if launched from its folder. You will not be able to load your Steam saves that way, as Steam Cloud, along with all the other Steam features, will be disabled.

notes.title: Speed up patch
notes.notes:
Now, the weekend is over, and we released another small patch, below the changes:


    Added controls for speeding up the game.
    Fixed the capturing of monsters and putting them in the zoo/aquarium.
    Moving buildings and bridges is now quite cheaper.
    Fixed a bug in the Resource Market, that made it possible to try buying more resources than you could store, which just took your gold.
